segments.title: Which country has the MOST time zones?
segments.say: Which country has the most time zones? Russia, the USA, or France? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's France!
segments.say: It's France! Twelve time zones, and thirteen with daylight saving.

segments.title: Thanks to its territories
segments.say: That's because of French territories spread around the globe.

segments.title: Russia and USA: 11 each
segments.say: Russia and the USA tie for second, with eleven each.

segments.sub: Did you say Russia? Be honest
segments.say: Did you say Russia? Be honest. Comment below.
